verses.original: צַדִּ֤יק אַתָּה֙ יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י אָרִ֖יב אֵלֶ֑יךָ אַ֤ךְ מִשְׁפָּטִים֙ אֲדַבֵּ֣ר אוֹתָ֔ךְ מַדּ֗וּעַ דֶּ֤רֶךְ רְשָׁעִים֙ צָלֵ֔חָה שָׁל֖וּ כָּל־ בֹּ֥גְדֵי בָֽגֶד׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq ’at·tāh Yah·weh kî ’ā·rîḇ ’ê·le·ḵā ’aḵ miš·pā·ṭîm ’ă·ḏab·bêr ’ō·w·ṯāḵ mad·dū·a‘ de·reḵ rə·šā·‘îm ṣā·lê·ḥāh šā·lū kāl- bō·ḡə·ḏê ḇā·ḡeḏ
verses.literal: Righteous are You O LORD when I plead before You Yet about Your judgments I wish to contend with You Why does the way of the wicked prosper Why do all the faithless . . . . . . live at ease
verses.literalPt: Justo és tu, Jeová, quando eu pleitear contigo; contudo, pleitearei a causa contigo. Por que prospera o caminho dos iníquos? Por que vivem em paz todos os que procedem aleivosamente?

verses.original: נְטַעְתָּם֙ גַּם־ שֹׁרָ֔שׁוּ יֵלְכ֖וּ גַּם־ עָ֣שׂוּ פֶ֑רִי קָר֤וֹב אַתָּה֙ בְּפִיהֶ֔ם וְרָח֖וֹק מִכִּלְיוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ṭa‘·tām gam- šō·rā·šū yê·lə·ḵū gam- ‘ā·śū p̄e·rî qā·rō·wḇ ’at·tāh bə·p̄î·hem wə·rā·ḥō·wq mik·kil·yō·w·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: You planted them and they have taken root They have grown and produced fruit . . . You are ever on their lips but far from their hearts
verses.literalPt: Plantaste-os, e lançaram raízes; medraram, dão fruto; perto estás na boca deles, mas longe dos seus rins.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ יְדַעְתָּ֔נִי תִּרְאֵ֕נִי וּבָחַנְתָּ֥ לִבִּ֖י אִתָּ֑ךְ הַתִּקֵם֙ כְּצֹ֣אן לְטִבְחָ֔ה וְהַקְדִּשֵׁ֖ם לְי֥וֹם הֲרֵגָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh Yah·weh yə·ḏa‘·tā·nî tir·’ê·nî ū·ḇā·ḥan·tā lib·bî ’it·tāḵ hat·ti·qêm kə·ṣōn lə·ṭiḇ·ḥāh wə·haq·di·šêm lə·yō·wm hă·rê·ḡāh
verses.literal: But You know me O LORD You see me and test my heart toward You Drag away the wicked like sheep to the slaughter and set them apart for the day of carnage
verses.literalPt: Porém tu, Jeová, me conheces; tu me vês e provas o meu coração para contigo. Arranca-os como ovelhas destinadas para o matadouro e prepara-os para o dia da matança.

verses.original: עַד־ מָתַי֙ תֶּאֱבַ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ וְעֵ֥שֶׂב כָּל־ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה יִיבָ֑שׁ מֵרָעַ֣ת יֹֽשְׁבֵי־ בָ֗הּ סָפְתָ֤ה בְהֵמוֹת֙ וָע֔וֹף כִּ֣י אָמְר֔וּ לֹ֥א יִרְאֶ֖ה אֶת־ אַחֲרִיתֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay te·’ĕ·ḇal hā·’ā·reṣ wə·‘ê·śeḇ kāl- haś·śā·ḏeh yî·ḇāš mê·rā·‘aṯ yō·šə·ḇê- ḇāh sā·p̄ə·ṯāh ḇə·hê·mō·wṯ wā·‘ō·wp̄ kî ’ā·mə·rū lō yir·’eh ’eṯ- ’a·ḥă·rî·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: How long . . . will the land mourn and the grass of every field be withered Because of the evil of its residents the animals and birds have been swept away for the people have said He cannot see what our end will be
verses.literalPt: Até quando lamentará a terra, e murchará a erva do campo todo? Por causa da maldade dos que nela habitam, consumidos foram os animais e as aves, porque disseram: Ele não verá o nosso fim.

verses.original: כִּ֣י אֶת־ רַגְלִ֥ים׀ רַ֙צְתָּה֙ וַיַּלְא֔וּךָ וְאֵ֥יךְ תְּתַֽחֲרֶ֖ה אֶת־ הַסּוּסִ֑ים וּבְאֶ֤רֶץ שָׁלוֹם֙ אַתָּ֣ה בוֹטֵ֔חַ וְאֵ֥יךְ תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בִּגְא֥וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- raḡ·lîm raṣ·tāh way·yal·’ū·ḵā wə·’êḵ tə·ṯa·ḥă·reh ’eṯ- has·sū·sîm ū·ḇə·’e·reṣ šā·lō·wm ’at·tāh ḇō·w·ṭê·aḥ wə·’êḵ ta·‘ă·śeh biḡ·’ō·wn hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: If you have raced with men on foot and they have worn you out how can you compete with horses If you stumble in a peaceful land how will you do in the thickets of the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Se, correndo com os que iam a pé, te fizeram cansar, então, como podes competir com os cavalos? Embora numa terra de paz estejas seguro, como hás de fazer na soberba do Jordão?

verses.original: כִּ֧י גַם־ אַחֶ֣יךָ וּבֵית־ אָבִ֗יךָ גַּם־ הֵ֙מָּה֙ בָּ֣גְדוּ בָ֔ךְ גַּם־ הֵ֛מָּה קָרְא֥וּ אַחֲרֶ֖יךָ מָלֵ֑א אַל־ תַּאֲמֵ֣ן בָּ֔ם כִּֽי־ יְדַבְּר֥וּ אֵלֶ֖יךָ טוֹבֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḡam- ’a·ḥe·ḵā ū·ḇêṯ- ’ā·ḇî·ḵā gam- hêm·māh bā·ḡə·ḏū ḇāḵ gam- hêm·māh qā·rə·’ū ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā mā·lê ’al- ta·’ă·mên bām kî- yə·ḏab·bə·rū ’ê·le·ḵā ṭō·w·ḇō·wṯ
verses.literal: Even . . . your brothers your own father’s household even they have betrayed you even they have cried aloud against you Do not trust them though they speak well of you
verses.literalPt: Pois até teus irmãos, e a casa de teu pai, até esses mesmos se houveram aleivosamente contigo; até esses clamaram após ti a grandes vozes. Não te fies deles, ainda que te dirijam boas palavras.

verses.original: עָזַ֙בְתִּי֙ אֶת־ בֵּיתִ֔י נָטַ֖שְׁתִּי אֶת־ נַחֲלָתִ֑י נָתַ֛תִּי אֶת־ יְדִד֥וּת נַפְשִׁ֖י בְּכַ֥ף אֹיְבֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·zaḇ·tî ’eṯ- bê·ṯî nā·ṭaš·tî ’eṯ- na·ḥă·lā·ṯî nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- yə·ḏi·ḏūṯ nap̄·šî bə·ḵap̄ ’ō·yə·ḇe·hā
verses.literal: I have forsaken My house I have abandoned My inheritance I have given the beloved of My soul into the hands of her enemies
verses.literalPt: Deixei a minha casa, abandonei a minha herança; entreguei a amada da minha alma às mãos dos seus inimigos.

verses.original: הָיְתָה־ לִּ֥י נַחֲלָתִ֖י כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה בַיָּ֑עַר נָתְנָ֥ה עָלַ֛י בְּקוֹלָ֖הּ עַל־ כֵּ֥ן שְׂנֵאתִֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: hā·yə·ṯāh- lî na·ḥă·lā·ṯî kə·’ar·yêh ḇay·yā·‘ar nā·ṯə·nāh ‘ā·lay bə·qō·w·lāh ‘al- kên śə·nê·ṯî·hā
verses.literal: My inheritance has become to Me like a lion in the forest She has roared . . . against Me therefore . . . I hate her
verses.literalPt: A minha herança tornou-se-me como leão no bosque; levantou a voz contra mim; por isso, eu a aborreço.

verses.original: הַעַ֨יִט צָב֤וּעַ נַחֲלָתִי֙ לִ֔י הַעַ֖יִט סָבִ֣יב עָלֶ֑יהָ לְכ֗וּ אִסְפ֛וּ כָּל־ חַיַּ֥ת הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה הֵתָ֥יוּ לְאָכְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ha·‘a·yiṭ ṣā·ḇū·a‘ na·ḥă·lā·ṯî lî ha·‘a·yiṭ sā·ḇîḇ ‘ā·le·hā lə·ḵū ’is·p̄ū kāl- ḥay·yaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh hê·ṯā·yū lə·’āḵ·lāh
verses.literal: Is not My inheritance to Me like a speckled bird of prey with other birds of prey circling against her Go gather all the beasts of the field bring them to devour her
verses.literalPt: Acaso, é para mim a minha herança como uma ave de rapina de várias cores? Acaso, as aves de rapina se voltam contra ela de todos os lados? Ide, ajuntai todos os animais do campo, trazei-os para a devorarem.

verses.original: רֹעִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ שִֽׁחֲת֣וּ כַרְמִ֔י בֹּסְס֖וּ אֶת־ חֶלְקָתִ֑י נָֽתְנ֛וּ אֶת־ חֶלְקַ֥ת חֶמְדָּתִ֖י לְמִדְבַּ֥ר שְׁמָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rō·‘îm rab·bîm ši·ḥă·ṯū ḵar·mî bō·sə·sū ’eṯ- ḥel·qā·ṯî nā·ṯə·nū ’eṯ- ḥel·qaṯ ḥem·dā·ṯî lə·miḏ·bar šə·mā·māh
verses.literal: Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard they have trampled My plot of ground They have turned My pleasant field into a desolate wasteland
verses.literalPt: Muitos pastores destruíram a minha vinha, calcaram aos pés a minha porção, fizeram da minha aprazível porção um ermo desolado.

verses.original: שָׂמָהּ֙ לִשְׁמָמָ֔ה אָבְלָ֥ה עָלַ֖י שְׁמֵמָ֑ה נָשַׁ֙מָּה֙ כָּל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ כִּ֛י אֵ֥ין אִ֖ישׁ שָׂ֥ם עַל־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: śā·māh liš·mā·māh ’ā·ḇə·lāh ‘ā·lay šə·mê·māh nā·šam·māh kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ kî ’ên ’îš śām ‘al- lêḇ
verses.literal: They have made it a desolation desolate before Me it mourns All the land is laid waste but no man takes it to heart
verses.literalPt: Tornaram-na em desolação; ela, assolada, pranteia ao meu pesar. Toda a terra está devastada, porque ninguém toma isso a peito.

verses.original: עַֽל־ כָּל־ שְׁפָיִ֣ם בַּמִּדְבָּ֗ר בָּ֚אוּ שֹֽׁדְדִ֔ים כִּ֣י חֶ֤רֶב לַֽיהוָה֙ אֹֽכְלָ֔ה מִקְצֵה־ אֶ֖רֶץ וְעַד־ קְצֵ֣ה הָאָ֑רֶץ אֵ֥ין שָׁל֖וֹם לְכָל־ בָּשָֽׂר׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kāl- šə·p̄ā·yim bam·miḏ·bār bā·’ū šō·ḏə·ḏîm kî ḥe·reḇ Yah·weh ’ō·ḵə·lāh miq·ṣêh- ’e·reṣ wə·‘aḏ- qə·ṣêh hā·’ā·reṣ ’ên šā·lō·wm lə·ḵāl bā·śār
verses.literal: Over all the barren heights in the wilderness the destroyers have come for the sword of the LORD devours from one end of the earth to the other . . . No . . . flesh has peace
verses.literalPt: Sobre todos os altos escalvados do deserto são vindos despojadores, porque a espada de Jeová devora desde uma até outra extremidade da terra; não há paz para nenhuma carne.

verses.original: זָרְע֤וּ חִטִּים֙ וְקֹצִ֣ים קָצָ֔רוּ נֶחְל֖וּ לֹ֣א יוֹעִ֑לוּ וּבֹ֙שׁוּ֙ מִתְּבוּאֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם מֵחֲר֖וֹן אַף־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: zā·rə·‘ū ḥiṭ·ṭîm wə·qō·ṣîm qā·ṣā·rū neḥ·lū lō yō·w·‘i·lū ū·ḇō·šū mit·tə·ḇū·’ō·ṯê·ḵem mê·ḥă·rō·wn ’ap̄- Yah·weh
verses.literal: They have sown wheat but harvested thorns They have exhausted themselves to no avail Bear the shame of your harvest because of the fierce anger of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Semearam trigo, mas ceifaram espinhos; cansaram-se, mas não recebem proveito algum. Envergonhados sereis dos vossos frutos por causa do ardor da ira de Jeová.

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל־ כָּל־ שְׁכֵנַי֙ הָֽרָעִ֔ים הַנֹּֽגְעִים֙ בַּֽנַּחֲלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ הִנְחַ֥לְתִּי אֶת־ עַמִּ֖י אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִנְנִ֤י נֹֽתְשָׁם֙ מֵעַ֣ל אַדְמָתָ֔ם וְאֶת־ בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה אֶתּ֥וֹשׁ מִתּוֹכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ‘al- kāl- šə·ḵê·nay hā·rā·‘îm han·nō·ḡə·‘îm ban·na·ḥă·lāh ’ă·šer- hin·ḥal·tî ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl hin·nî nō·ṯə·šām mê·‘al ’aḏ·mā·ṯām wə·’eṯ- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh ’et·tō·wōš mit·tō·w·ḵām
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says As for all My evil neighbors who attack the inheritance that I bequeathed to My people Israel . . . I am about to uproot them from their land and I will uproot the house of Judah from among them
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová acerca de todos os meus maus vizinhos, que tocam a herança que fiz herdar o meu povo de Israel: Eis que os arrancarei a eles da sua terra e arrancarei a casa de Judá do meio deles.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה אַֽחֲרֵי֙ נָתְשִׁ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם אָשׁ֖וּב וְרִֽחַמְתִּ֑ים וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֛ים אִ֥ישׁ לְנַחֲלָת֖וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ לְאַרְצֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’a·ḥă·rê nā·ṯə·šî ’ō·w·ṯām ’ā·šūḇ wə·ri·ḥam·tîm wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯîm ’îš lə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw wə·’îš lə·’ar·ṣōw
verses.literal: But after I have uprooted them I will once again have compassion on them and return each one to his inheritance . . . and to his land
verses.literalPt: Depois de os ter eu arrancado, tornarei e me compadecerei deles; fá-los-ei voltar, cada um para a sua herança e cada um para a sua terra.

verses.original: וְהָיָ֡ה אִם־ לָמֹ֣ד יִלְמְדוּ֩ אֶת־ דַּֽרְכֵ֨י עַמִּ֜י לְהִשָּׁבֵ֤עַ בִּשְׁמִי֙ חַי־ יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר לִמְּדוּ֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י לְהִשָּׁבֵ֖עַ בַּבָּ֑עַל וְנִבְנ֖וּ בְּת֥וֹךְ עַמִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- lā·mōḏ yil·mə·ḏū ’eṯ- dar·ḵê ‘am·mî lə·hiš·šā·ḇê·a‘ biš·mî ḥay- Yah·weh ka·’ă·šer lim·mə·ḏū ’eṯ- ‘am·mî lə·hiš·šā·ḇê·a‘ bab·bā·‘al wə·niḇ·nū bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘am·mî
verses.literal: And if they will diligently learn . . . the ways of My people and swear by My name, saying As surely as the LORD lives just as they once taught My people to swear by Baal then they will be established among My people
verses.literalPt: Se aprenderem diligentemente os caminhos do meu povo, jurando pelo meu nome… Pela vida de Jeová, assim como ensinaram o meu povo a jurar por Baal; serão edificados no meio do meu povo.

verses.original: וְאִ֖ם לֹ֣א יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ וְנָ֨תַשְׁתִּ֜י אֶת־ הַגּ֥וֹי הַה֛וּא נָת֥וֹשׁ וְאַבֵּ֖ד נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’im lō yiš·mā·‘ū wə·nā·ṯaš·tî ’eṯ- hag·gō·w ha·hū nā·ṯō·wōš wə·’ab·bêḏ nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: But if they will not obey then I will uproot that nation I will uproot it and destroy it declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porém, se não ouvirem, arrancarei essa nação, arrancando-a e destruindo-a, diz Jeová.
